Name: (Repeal) Town expansion space
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=6][quote][center][color=#ffff00]This mod has been discontinued since content was added to this location in SDV 1.6.[/color][/center][/quote][/size]




Add a generic space in the upper right corner of the city.


If you want to use the "Enable the generate bushes in the area" on a saved game, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Entoarox Framework[/url] and type [color=#ff0000][size=4]world_reset bushes[/size][/color] in the SMAPI console.

"Enable the crops grow in the town" will allow crops to grow in the entire town map, not just in the expansion space area.
This is done because the system does not allow to enable the setting for only a part of the map.



v1.1~
File has been made to work in CP for stability.
TMX is no longer needed.
**** CAUTION ****
Please delete old files (folders) when updating.
The old folder is "[TMX] Town expansion space".

Supported in version 1.3.
